tasks.instruction: W kazdym zdaniu sa dwie luki. Wybierz pare wyrazow, ktora pasuje do obu.

items.stem: She broke her toe when she _________ _________ her bike.
There _________ furniture in this office, we need to remove _________.
I have a dentist appointment _________. Can you give me _________?
options: A) tomorrow in the morning / the lift
C) in tomorrow's morning / the lift

items.stem: As long as you _________ when you _________, I will meet you at the airport.
options: A) let me know / will arrive
B) will let me know / arrive

items.stem: I don't know this word. I _________ look it _________ in a dictionary.
